result.detail: Fixed held-out set with policy_context as reference, TransE and RotatE, two seeds, 100 epochs. Hub pruning (removing context hubs shared by more than 50 targets; 130,670 triples) gives +0.0234/-0.0035 macro/micro under TransE and +0.0445/+0.0107 under RotatE; adding 2,610 subclass_of edges (163,072 triples) gives +0.0545/-0.0003 and +0.0110/+0.0012. Evidence subtypes give +0.0205/-0.0057 and +0.0098/-0.0016, while entity-type triples give +0.0588/+0.0028 under TransE but -0.0128/-0.0169 under RotatE; the types arm has macro sigma 0.026.
